package.name: aav_planner
package.description: Our own path planner in Rust (rclrs): Nav2's Smac State Lattice ported (our lattice primitives file, the search, its costs and penalties, the Reeds-Shepp or Dubins finish, the smoother), checking the car's outline on the global costmap. A trial beside Nav2's planner_server (navigation.launch.py planner:=own): it serves nav2_msgs/action/ComputePathToPose on /drivers/nav/planner/compute_path_to_pose, and bt_navigator's trees call it instead of planner_server's.
